hero.headline: Custom Concrete Pools Built For Pennsylvania Winters
hero.subheadline: Gunite pools, integrated spas, renovations, repairs and seasonal service — designed around the ground under your yard and a climate that swings from 90°F to -10°F. Local crews across Luzerne and Lackawanna counties.

promise_band.headline: One Company, Start To Finish
promise_band.body: The crew that excavates your yard is the crew that shoots the gunite, sets the coping, lays the deck, and comes back in April to open the pool. Nothing gets handed to a subcontractor and nothing gets blamed on one. When something needs attention in year six, you call the same number you called in year one, and you get the people who built it.

signature_system.headline: From Design Consult To Champagne Toast
signature_system.intro: Every SpringLake pool runs the same way. You get a plan drawn around your actual backyard, a crew that stays on the job, and clear communication from the first measurement to the final walkthrough.

blocks.title: Designed around your yard, not a catalogue
blocks.body: We measure slopes, check sight lines from the house, and plan around existing landscaping and utility lines. Infinity edges, sun ledges, benches, grottos, acrylic walls and integrated spas are all on the table — 3D CAD design and hundreds of tile samples let you see it before we dig.

blocks.title: Gunite, because of the winters
blocks.body: Spray-applied concrete creates the strongest shell available and takes any shape a lot demands — curving around mature oaks, fitting a narrow Back Mountain lot, or stepping down a slope near Lake Silkworth. We have gunite pools still sound after 20+ Pennsylvania winters.

about_block.headline: A Local Builder Who Actually Lives Here
about_block.body: We are a family-owned company building custom concrete pools and spas across the Back Mountain and the Wyoming Valley. We are not a corporation running jobs out of another county. seo_body.headline: Custom Concrete Pools In Dallas, PA
paragraphs: Northeastern Pennsylvania is hard on pools. Freeze-thaw cycles crack plaster and work at coping until water gets behind the shell. Rocky ledge and clay make excavation a design problem, not a formality. A pool built to a generic national spec does not survive that the way one engineered for it does.

We build gunite shells that handle the swing from 90°F summers to -10°F winters, set plumbing below frost level, and finish with masonry from our own crew. Then we stay — renovations, resurfacing, leak detection, weekly maintenance, and the seasonal opening and closing that is the single best protection against a spring repair bill.
checklist: Gunite and concrete pool construction, plus integrated spas
Renovation, replastering, tile, coping and full remodels
Leak detection, resurfacing and emergency repair
Weekly maintenance, chemical balancing and water testing
Masonry: waterfalls, pavers, retaining walls, fire pits, outdoor kitchens

faqs.q: Why concrete or gunite instead of fiberglass or vinyl?
faqs.a: Gunite is spray-applied concrete, which produces the strongest shell available and can take any shape your lot demands — curving around mature trees, fitting a narrow lot, or stepping down a slope. In this climate that strength matters, and we have gunite pools still sound after more than twenty Pennsylvania winters.

faqs.q: What does the free consultation include?
faqs.a: We come to your property, walk the yard, talk through what you want, and take real measurements — slopes, sight lines from the house, existing landscaping, utility lines. Most consultations run one to two hours because we measure everything and explain the options rather than handing you a number over the phone.

faqs.q: Do you handle the masonry and hardscape, or is that a separate contractor?
faqs.a: We handle it. Coping, pool decks, pavers, stone walls, retaining structures, fire pits, water features and complete outdoor kitchens are done by our own crew. That is why the hardscape and the pool meet the way the design drawing said they would.

faqs.q: Can you renovate a pool you did not build?
faqs.a: Yes. Replastering, waterline tile, coping, sandblasting, patio and deck resurfacing, depth changes, added spas and water features, tanning ledges and travertine pavers are all standard renovation work for us. Our plaster options carry lifetime warranties and can be brought back to new colour without the demolition most pool plaster requires.

faqs.q: Do you offer weekly service and seasonal opening and closing?
faqs.a: Yes. Openings usually start in April depending on weather — covers off and stored, equipment restarted, chemistry balanced, swim-ready inside a week. Closings drain lines below frost level, add antifreeze where needed and install winter covers, which is what prevents expensive freeze damage. Weekly maintenance, chemical balancing and professional water testing are available in between.

Dallas, Shavertown, Trucksville, Back Mountain, Harveys Lake, Bear Creek and Mountain Top across Luzerne County, plus Wilkes-Barre, Clarks Summit, Scranton, Pittston and Waverly in and around Lackawanna County. Our crews also work out toward Sweet Valley, Tunkhannock and the Poconos.

faqs.q: What should I do first if my pool is leaking?
faqs.a: Call us. Leak detection needs electronic listening equipment and pressure testing to find failures in the shell, plumbing lines or equipment — most of them turn up at pipe joints or where plumbing enters the pool. Guessing at it usually costs more than diagnosing it properly, and we offer emergency repair when a pool fails mid-season.
